name: Dr. Hausverstand
props: short open white coat and burgundy tie
personality: He has seen something like it before and is trying to leave enough room for it to be different.
biography: Hausverstand arrives in the HyperNorm practice with his old bag and an expression that has outlasted several reorganisations. A card allowing experience to remain open to surprise lifts his uneven brow: a concern is either familiar or not yet properly explained. Men in Black value dependable judgement. He holds the wooden spatula low, giving the next account a little more time than his certainty intended.
note: Der Fall ist bekannt. Seine besonderen Umstände wurden trotzdem zum Gespräch gebeten.

name: Dr. Zuwendung
props: open white coat panels and pastel-green collar
personality: She can listen beyond the allotted answer and finds the timetable's objections less persuasive each time.
biography: Zuwendung holds the stethoscope below a small crooked smile in the HyperNorm consulting corner. A card allowing understanding to include not yet knowing lowers one eyelid: an account is either heard or still asking for attention. Hunky & Dory request efficient reassurance. She glances sideways at the empty moment between appointments, reluctant to let the schedule decide what has been said.
note: Die Sprechzeit ist abgelaufen. Das Zuhören hat davon noch keinen Gebrauch gemacht.

name: Dr. Messlatte
props: short white coat lapels and muted blue collar
classic pressure cuff, round unnumbered dial and black bulb
temperament: analytical worry / dependence on a definite reading
personality: He trusts the reading most immediately before he asks whether it has been read carefully enough.
biography: Messlatte studies the little dial in the HyperNorm practice with a face that has not yet accepted the reassurance it requested. A card allowing measurement to leave a question open raises his inner brows: a result is either definite or insufficiently checked. Men in Black request an unambiguous account. He steadies the cuff, hoping precision will explain how certain he is entitled to feel.
note: Der Wert ist ermittelt. Seine Eindeutigkeit wird nochmals um Auskunft gebeten.

name: Dr. SagenSie
props: small silver head mirror above eyes
personality: She would like an uncomplicated answer and is prepared to examine the complication personally.
biography: SagenSie keeps the penlight pointed low in the HyperNorm examination corner while her eyebrows conduct a considerably less patient inquiry. A card allowing clarity to require another question clenches her uneven teeth: an answer is either clear or in need of closer attention. Hunky & Dory request a prompt conclusion. She waits, trying not to let the force of the request replace what she is meant to notice.
note: Die Aufforderung ist deutlich. Der Befund möchte unabhängig davon gehört werden.

name: Dr. Unverzüglich
personality: He regards a prompt response as encouraging and an unexpected one as the beginning of a better afternoon.
biography: Unverzüglich holds a small hammer and a tuning fork in the HyperNorm checkup corner with a grin already anticipating an answer. A card allowing a delayed response to retain meaning lifts his curious eye: a reaction is either prompt or inviting investigation. Men in Black prefer predictable outcomes. He keeps both tools low, quietly delighted by the possibility that the next observation will need another look.
note: Die Reaktion wird erwartet. Der Erwartende ist bereits erfreulich angeregt.

name: Dr. Nachschrift
props: blank prescription pad with curled edge
personality: He remembers that the conclusion belongs on paper and is trying to recover the conclusion from that obligation.
biography: Nachschrift holds a blank pad in the HyperNorm practice with the pen poised below his worried upward gaze. A card allowing a record to preserve an unfinished thought deepens his crooked pout: a conclusion is either written or liable to be lost. Hunky & Dory request complete documentation. He pauses, giving the thing he meant another chance to arrive before its official wording.
note: Die Niederschrift ist vorbereitet. Der zugehörige Gedanke wurde nochmals aufgerufen.
